description: Dual-mode notification component: dismissible banner or bell-icon panel with history + read tracking.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Which presentation mode to render (default: panel)

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: Banner mode: VBStore key used to record dismiss state

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Banner mode: color variant (reactive)

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Banner mode: top = sticky to the viewport top, bottom = fixed to the viewport bottom (reactive)

attributes.name: expires
attributes.description: Banner mode: days until the banner re-shows after dismiss

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Panel mode: absolute or root-relative URL, or a VBService role name, for dynamic notifications

attributes.name: poll
attributes.description: Panel mode: polling interval in milliseconds

attributes.name: toast-new
attributes.description: Panel mode: on each poll after the first, show a toast for every never-seen dynamic notification on the <toast-msg> matched by the value (a selector, e.g. #id); bare, invalid, or no matching <toast-msg> = first <toast-msg> in the document

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Panel mode: VBStore namespace for read state (default: notifications)

attributes.name: data-label-trigger
attributes.description: Panel mode: Trigger accessible name (minted bell; an authored trigger keeps its own name).

attributes.name: data-label-unread
attributes.description: Panel mode: Unread count appended to the trigger name ({n} = count).

attributes.name: data-label-title
attributes.description: Panel mode: Panel heading and dialog name.

attributes.name: data-label-mark-all
attributes.description: Panel mode: Mark-all button text.

attributes.name: data-label-tabs
attributes.description: Panel mode: Tab list accessible name.

attributes.name: data-label-all
attributes.description: Panel mode: All tab text.

attributes.name: data-label-watching
attributes.description: Panel mode: Watching tab text.

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Panel mode: Empty-state text for the All tab.

attributes.name: data-label-watch-empty
attributes.default: You aren’t watching any pages yet. Use the “Watch” button on a page to start.
attributes.description: Panel mode: Empty-state text for the Watching tab.

attributes.name: data-label-last-checked
attributes.description: Panel mode: Watch row check time ({date} = formatted date).

attributes.name: data-label-never
attributes.description: Panel mode: Watch row check time when never checked.

attributes.name: data-label-changed
attributes.description: Panel mode: Badge on watched pages whose content changed.

attributes.name: data-label-unwatch
attributes.description: Panel mode: Unwatch button accessible name ({title} = page title).

attributes.name: data-label-new
attributes.description: Panel mode: Toast text when a new notification has no title or body.

attributes.name: data-label-variant-info
attributes.description: Banner mode: visually hidden prefix announcing the info variant, so it isn't conveyed by colour alone.

attributes.name: data-label-variant-success
attributes.description: Banner mode: visually hidden prefix announcing the success variant, so it isn't conveyed by colour alone.

attributes.name: data-label-variant-warning
attributes.description: Banner mode: visually hidden prefix announcing the warning variant, so it isn't conveyed by colour alone.

attributes.name: data-label-variant-error
attributes.description: Banner mode: visually hidden prefix announcing the error variant, so it isn't conveyed by colour alone.

events.name: notification-wc:new
events.description: A never-seen entry arrived in a dynamic fetch

events.name: notification-wc:notifications-changed
events.description: The notifications setter replaced the dynamic list

events.name: page-watch:remove
events.description: A page was unwatched from the Watching tab

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Panel mode: marks an authored trigger button that replaces the minted bell. An unread badge is appended inside it.

childAttributes.name: data-id
childAttributes.description: Panel mode: notification id (read state and dynamic merge key).

childAttributes.name: data-date
childAttributes.description: Panel mode: ISO date; sorts rows newest first and is shown formatted in the document language.

childAttributes.name: value
childAttributes.description: Banner mode: value="dismiss" (or data-dismiss) marks the dismiss button.

properties.name: notifications
properties.type: Array<{ id, title, body?, date?, type?, url?, dismissed? }>
properties.description: Panel mode: dynamic notifications merged over static <article> children by id (same shape as the src feed). The getter returns a copy; the setter re-renders and fires notification-wc:notifications-changed. url renders as a link only when it resolves to http(s). Banner mode ignores the setter.
